text.text:
/prusaconnect help: What this bot can do.
/prusaconnect status [printer] [--here]: What the printers are doing. --here posts it in the channel. (in #bots)
/prusaconnect jobs [printer]: The last prints. (in #bots)
/prusaconnect snap [printer]: A picture from a printer's camera, posted in the channel. (in #bots)
/prusaconnect signup: Make your account on the printer server (denhac members with 3D Printer User).
/prusaconnect password: Set a new password on your account.
/prusaconnect whoami: What the bot knows about you.
/prusaconnect link [code]: Link your Slack user to an account you already have on the printer server.
/prusaconnect bot: How the bot itself is doing.
/prusaconnect suspend [@user|username|member code] [reason]: Turn an account off until an admin lifts it. Alone, lists the suspensions. (admins)
/prusaconnect unsuspend <@user|username|member code>: Lift a suspension. (admins)
/prusaconnect lookup <@user|username|member code>: Which member code, Slack user and account belong together. (admins)
